whatsappMessage:
Hi Dr. Anant,

I noticed SmileNêst Dental Clinic has an impressive 5.0★ rating with wonderful patient feedback in Kadamkuan, Patna, but your online presence is running on a basic template page.

Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek custom high-performance website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp appointment booking, painless treatment highlights, aur complete dental services menu integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/smilenest

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript:
"Hi Dr. Anant, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke clinic (SmileNêst Dental Clinic) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha."

"Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya?"

*(Branch A - If they checked it)*: "Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp appointment booking and your 5.0-star patient reviews in Kadamkuan, Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?"

*(Branch B - If they haven't checked yet)*: "No problem at all! Direct live link aapke WhatsApp par hai. Whenever you get 2 minutes ek baar open karke check kariyega—koi commitment nahi hai, just wanted to share the idea and get your feedback."

"Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual clinic photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
